scope: complete strict LU: all i>k,j>k MACs plus strict-L divisions
address_model: canonical CSC factor union; FP32+uint32 8-byte records; L/U/diagonal updated in place
operation_segment_order_semantics: exact segment-native trace with operation-VLIW16 metadata
operation_block_order_semantics: exact target-resident block trace with operation-VLIW16 metadata
block_semantics: legal target-resident left-looking completion of diagonal/panel blocks before GETRF/GESSM/TSTRF; every SSSSM block uses j,k,i atoms
factor_kernel_semantics: GETRF and GESSM are column-oriented j,k,i; TSTRF is row-oriented i,k,j; GETRF/TSTRF divisions precede same-pivot updates
block_kij_jki_inner_semantics: strict right-looking K,I,J tasks with oriented factor kernels and j,k,i SSSSM atoms
